content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-172. - Unsafe tethering.
content.summary:

               caus…

faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for the owner or custodian of any animal to tether any animal
               in such a manner that the animal may become entangled and unable to reach shelter
               or water, or in such a manner that the animal may be injured, strangled, or otherwise
               caused to suffer.
